visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long wavy brown hair, wearing a white t-shirt and light blue skirt, stands by a window in a bright indoor room. She pulls back white sheer curtains to look outside at a city skyline with water. (2) She coughs and covers her mouth with her hand while standing by the window. Animated grey particles float around her. (3) She looks at her arm with a distressed expression as black animated icons resembling bacteria appear on her skin. (4) She wraps a grey textured towel around her neck and shoulders, shivering while looking up at an air conditioning unit that is blowing cold air. (5) Sitting on a white sofa, she uses a hairdryer. Several white rectangular overlay boxes with text and downward arrows appear around her, representing multiple digital notifications. (6) A series of close-up photos show red, irritated patches of skin on a person's arm and face. (7) The woman sits on the sofa and presents two white Nivea containers: a large pump bottle and a round tub. She gestures with her hands while smiling at the camera. (8) Close-up shots show the white lotion being pumped into a hand and then applied to a neck and an arm. (9) She holds both products up to the camera, smiling, while graphical checkboxes with text appear next to the items. (10) The final scene shows the woman sitting on the sofa in the background, slightly out of focus, while the two Nivea products are prominently displayed on a wooden table in the foreground.

(3) The female voice shifts to a slightly concerned tone, describing skin issues, while more digital 'ping' sound effects occur rapidly. (4) A low-frequency 'whoosh' sound effect marks a scene transition, accompanied by the faint, airy hum of an air conditioner. (5) Several rapid-fire 'pop' and 'click' sound effects play in succession, mimicking the arrival of multiple phone notifications as the narrator's speed increases. (6) The music remains constant but the narrator transitions back to a friendly, enthusiastic tone to introduce a product. A rhythmic 'click' and 'squelch' sound of a pump being depressed is clearly audible. (7) The video concludes with a short musical jingle that fades out with the narrator giving a final positive endorsement.
